verdict.rationale: Cal.com publishes an extensive, per-endpoint API v2 reference covering bookings, slots, event types, webhooks with schema enums, schedules, and routing trace. It also serves machine-readable markdown pages and an llms.txt index, which helps AI-native exploration. However, nothing in the evidence shows an interactive playground or runnable examples, and the probe found no public OpenAPI spec at the standard paths. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive 'try it' console, runnable request/response examples, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration
